caption: The drawing depicts a single jug with a rounded, bulbous body and a narrow neck, tapering up to a small circular rim. There is a curved handle attached from the upper neck to the shoulder of the jug, following the contour of the vessel. The jug appears to be made of ceramic or stoneware, and its surface is glazed in muted shades of brown, green, and gray, with some subtle earthy tones and highlights indicating light reflection. The background of the drawing is plain and lightly textured in a beige or off-white color, with some visible stains or patches of discoloration around the edges. There is no other visible object or embellishment in the composition, keeping the focus solely on the jug. The artist's signature appears near the lower right corner.
title: Jug
